about: Without the shell, use your file search tools to find the Markdown files in this project, then search them for the word Friday and tell me which ones mention it. A file search matching in two files of three, one in a subdirectory, then the answer naming them.

known.line: tool #1 find find_file_by_name {"query":"**/*.md"} ->  attachments=plan.md application/octet-stream, notes.md application/octet-stream, todo.md application/octet-stream
known.reason: Devin 3000.10.23 replays a finished search on session/load as the call and a bare `completed` update, without the files it listed live. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store keeps the files.
